node.statement: Contradiction. For tau ∈ (0, 1/256] the budget bound gives C·tau < 1 (the constant C from the certificate satisfying C ≤ 256), so the available transverse moment C·tau is strictly less than the one unit demanded by the z-row. The two requirements sum_j P_{zj}·x_j = 1 and sum_j P_{zj}·x_j ≤ C·tau < 1 are jointly infeasible; hence no admissible z-row, and therefore no rank-three exact signed idempotent P realizing the pinned display, can exist.
